## Public-Safe Requirements

If this feature is public-facing, confirm:

- [ ] No guaranteed approval claims
- [ ] No guaranteed funding claims
- [ ] No guaranteed income/revenue claims
- [ ] No guaranteed ranking/traffic claims
- [ ] No credit repair promises
- [ ] No legal/tax/lending/investment advice presented as final guidance
- [ ] Affiliate/referral disclosure included if relevant
- [ ] Missing facts are marked as unknown instead of invented
- [ ] Examples are synthetic

## Acceptance Criteria

This feature is complete when:

- [ ] Feature file(s) exist
- [ ] Content is specific and useful
- [ ] Related indexes are updated where applicable
- [ ] Related navigation is updated where applicable
- [ ] Crosslinks point to real files
- [ ] Public-safe language is used
- [ ] CTAs work if included
- [ ] JSON validates if changed
- [ ] Static site loads locally if pages changed
- [ ] No secrets/private data are included
- [ ] No unrelated refactors are included

## Out of Scope

Do not include:

- Unrelated pages
- Unrelated agents/skills/knowledge bases
- Large redesigns
- Deployment changes unless explicitly required
- New frameworks or package managers
- Private customer/client/borrower data
- Secrets or credentials
